title: Build 23 distinct bosses, seven survivor classes and six arena layouts
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Adds fourteen distinct Midnight Circuit bosses and a real ten-fight route alongside the nine-boss Quarantine pool. Nine unique regulars and a reserved finale reach the normalized 27-SP and 2400-base-income budgets. All seven survivor kits, 378 nodes, 28 weapons and six distinct map footprints remain connected.

New signatures have actual counterplay: destructible nests, locked mold, rotating ring gaps, rescue tethers, missing polygon edges, splitting loaves stopped by cover, nondamaging currents, signaled rail carriages, protected shadow pockets, fixed caliper marks, restorative vine cuts, independently drawn/shared-health Choir casters, neutralizable sanctuary waves and alternating half-arena verdicts. Server simulation and prediction share environmental forces. Protocol 9 adds bounded old local migrations; online clients and signed saves remain strict.

Adds fourteen individually scored original themes, 128 drawn boss/part/minion poses and eight signature props. Exact native requests, portable references, a superseded release correction and independent source/atlas/pixel audits are retained. The earlier nine PCM masters remain byte-for-byte. Native and automated evidence does not establish final rendered, human/listening, physical-device, WAN or endurance acceptance.

Validation: 171 rules/WebSocket/HTTP/SQL checks, TypeScript, authored-content/fifteen-locale validation and production build; each new identity is exercised over real WebSocket rooms. Exact source/build evidence is in reviews/runtime-verification.json. All phases, counterplays, route uniqueness/budgets, shared damage and long-lived minion caps have focused coverage.

Keep draft and main protected. Thirty-seven boss identities, later modes, full action art, durable profiles/rankings/recovery and Windows/LAN release remain in development. Public hosting remains the earlier protocol-4 Site under a different account and is not redeployed by source/Wiki pushes.
